dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: So... you have this whole pad all to yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: That's impressive. You could raise... probably ten saurians here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: It's pretty great.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: There's fresh air, plenty of space, it's comfortable and cozy... Pets and saurians would feel right at home here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A true vet — always thinking about animals!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Heh, everyone's got their own focus. I'm sure you could teach me a thing or two about adventuring, for instance.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Or maybe... how to save the world, nation by nation?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds like a compliment...?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Of course. You helped Natlan in its hour of need. People like you deserve all the praise they can get.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: From what I see, you have a lot of experience surviving in the wild, and you have a real zest for life in general.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: In other words, you're exactly the kind of person I wanna be friends with.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh yeah? Why is that?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Well, people with a zest for life are usually proactive about keeping their homes clean and tidy, and they don't tend to cause trouble everywhere they go.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: It makes you much less of a liability, bro.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like... you see some of your other friends as liabilities?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Huh? Was it that obvious? Oh well...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is Ororon one of those friends?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Oh — no, he's fine. He leads a pretty benign life. For one thing, you can't hope to grow good crops if you're too out of control.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: I was actually talking about my saurian companions. I guess I also think of them as friends.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: A saurian in a bad mood is a lot more dangerous than a human. They'll rampage through your home like a storm if you're not careful.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: If that happens, all you can do in the moment is try to get them to calm down. Settling the score... that has to wait for another time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Sure thing.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: You picked a good moment — I actually have some snacks on me. You want some?

choices.text: Are they for feeding to saurians?

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: They're for whoever wants them. Me, you, or the saurians. It never hurts to carry some food with you.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Try this — it's some jerky that I grilled myself. It's really good, even if I do say so myself.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Yeah? I'm glad you like it. I also do other kinds with different seasonings. I'll bring a bigger variety next time we meet.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Uh, you can keep this bag of jerky, by the way. Next time you need to ingratiate yourself with a saurian, feed them some of this. It'll help.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Dunno if you have any immediate need for it, but... Anyway, hold onto it for now.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thanks, Ifa! This is so thoughtful of you...

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Aw, I'm glad you think so.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: To tell you the truth, I was pretty all over the place as a kid. I only got my act together after becoming a vet.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Tragedy is unavoidable in life. But everything passes in time.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Whatever difficulties you're facing in your own life, I wish you the very best in getting through them.

choices.text: Thank you, but... this is a little too chewy for me...

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Ah, whoops... I forgot, your teeth aren't nearly as sharp as a saurian's...

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Sorry about that. Let's try something else, then... I've also got some little cookies?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Mm, these are really crispy!

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Heh, hopefully a little easier on your teeth.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: I'd like to take a look around, see what you've done with this place. Maybe I'll pick up a thing or two about furnishing and decorating.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: I like how you've arranged some of your furnishings — it's fun and practical. I'm actually thinking about redecorating my own yard at the moment.

choices.text: Be my guest! Feel free to look around and ask any questions.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Haha, you don't charge tuition fees, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Maybe you can teach me something in return?

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Teach you something, huh? Hm... Lemme think...

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: I think I'd be hard-pressed to teach a seasoned adventurer like you any new tricks.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: But if I had to pick something... Okay, try this hand gesture.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Isn't that just a beckoning gesture?

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Yup. It might look simple, but the angle and the frequency of repetitions are key.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Not too fast, not too slow, just calm and gentle, with a sense of rhythm. That way, they can feel your energy.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: If you get it right, you'll have cats, dogs, and saurians coming up to say hi to you. They see it as a sign of friendship.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Today I learned!

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Useful little trick, huh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How about whistling? Does that work too?

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: I wouldn't recommend it. Maybe for smaller animals, but with most saurians, whistling can anger them.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Saurians can have big egos, and they're pretty intelligent creatures too. They won't appreciate being controlled or condescended to.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Fundamentally, dealing with saurians is no different from dealing with people. Honesty and respect goes a long way.

choices.text: Well, I do like to think of this place as my magnum opus.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Even more reason for me to take notes.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Ifa.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Morning. Fellow early riser, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: A solid routine is the key to a healthy, balanced life.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Ifa.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Good night. Don't stay up too late, sleep is precious.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: I have some medical charts to update, so I'll be up for a little while still.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: I like it! You'll only find buildings of this style in the Flower-Feather Clan. My own house looks just like this.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Don't be fooled by the rounded exterior. It's much more spacious on the inside than you'd expect.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Hmm? Looks like an onion? You really think so?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: This is a useful bunch of kit, bro. You should buy a set — you can't go wrong with this if you're looking to raise saurians.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: And if you're not looking to raise saurians, then uh... I'm sure Paimon would be right at home here?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: That said... what kind of creature IS Paimon, exactly? Hmm...
